items.wordHook: A dripping 丶(dot) glides into a sweeping stroke linking words together: 之(possessive particle "of").
Combining 倒(fall down) and 是(be): 倒是 means sure it is, but.
An 古(old) 儿(person) pins a wild horse down → 克(subdue).
參(take part) + 觀(observe) → taking part in looking around: 參觀(to visit).
When a weary 尸(body) manages to 至(reach) shelter, they enter a warm 屋(building).
The great 能(can) and spirit held deep in one's 心(heart) project a calm 態(manner).
A wrist with five fingers spread wide reaches out to grab → 手(hand).
Combining 相(mutual) and 處(reside at): 相處 means get along with.
花蓮 Hualien: picture a flower (花) and a lotus (蓮) blooming on Taiwan's east coast.
Combining 軍(army) and 隊(team): 軍隊 means army.
a 辶(movement) of 軍(soldiers) charges down the field → 運(run).
高(high) + 鐵(iron rail) → high-speed rail: 高鐵.
